_note: Machine-range rules: WHICH machines get WHICH apps, at building/room/machine-number granularity. Normally authored visually in Rooms & Rules -> Designer ('SAVE this room' writes this file, keeping a .bak). A rule either carries its own apps array (order = install order) or points at a rooms.json profile. The Designer also stores per-room health-chip settings here under roomHealth. Ships EMPTY - see _example_rule for the shape.
